description: Explicit allowlist for Microsoft source families that remain Missing only because their product responsibility is deliberately deferred beyond the already-completed Rust ownership slices. Any effective Missing contract outside this list fails the global inventory gate.

sources.reason: Only ReadingDbcsCharsPadsOutputArray remains: Rust owns DBCS padding/order once encoded bytes are supplied, but CP_JAPANESE conversion remains a Windows codepage adapter responsibility.

Safe Rust now owns the screen-buffer reflow-color, tab-stop, horizontal and vertical scrolling/line-edit, wide-glyph movement, rectangular-area, alternate-buffer lifecycle/resize/terminal-scrolling, deferred-main resize coordination, portable and reflow-coordinated virtual-bottom, hyperlink-map, portable cursor/margins/origin movement, saved-cursor, cursor-presentation, DECALN screen-alignment, terminal LNM/DECSCNM/DECAWM/DECECM modes, erase/selective-protection/RIS reset behavior, extended SGR/cell-attribute, OSC 133 command-region, delayed-wrap/multiline-autowrap, and LF/IND/NEL viewport-plus-margin coordination seams; the remaining methods require selection/API or other coordination state.
The C++ iterator operator API has no direct migrated Rust product abstraction.
Terminal application command-line behavior remains native product logic.
Filtered-command product action semantics remain native.
TerminalApp settings integration remains native product logic.
